SS-REPOSITORY.Purpose: Physical organization and cleanliness contract for FLI source, packages, integrations, tests, tooling, knowledge, and derived state.

Scope.SCP-IN-002: `packages/core`: harness-independent Core; `packages/skills`: canonical exported Agent Skill; `.agents/skills`: project-local skills.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: `integrations/<harness>`: one isolated subtree per harness; `tests`: centralized verification hierarchy; `scripts`: repository-wide operations.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Application source, arbitrary scripts, logs, reports, build outputs, snapshots, debug files at repository root.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Global catch-all directories; hidden unmanaged state; arbitrary persistent files under user home/config.

Principles.PRIN-001: High cohesion: component-specific source, assets, native code, tooling, and fixtures stay with their owner.
Principles.PRIN-002: Generated/transient output is not source; reproducibility inputs such as lockfiles are allowed in Git.
Principles.PRIN-003: Repository-wide repeatable operations live in `scripts/`; component-specific ones stay component-local; one-off/debug scripts stay in a temporary workspace.

Requirements.REQ-001: Build, run, test, model, and intermediate outputs are forbidden in Git.
Requirements.REQ-002: Reusable disposable state goes to the OS shared cache directory; ephemeral working state to the OS temporary directory; cache removal loses only acceleration/resume, never canonical truth.
Requirements.REQ-003: Published knowledge files are canonical source, not generated garbage.
Requirements.REQ-004: Component-specific non-TypeScript/native code is colocated with its owner.
Requirements.REQ-005: Source layout and import paths are not FLI parent authority.
